name: Persia

related_people.name: Artaxerxes
related_people.role: its king, who sent Ezra and later Nehemiah to Jerusalem

related_people.name: Cyrus
related_people.role: its king, who decreed the exiles' return to rebuild the temple

related_people.name: Darius
related_people.role: its king, who confirmed Cyrus's decree and funded the temple's completion

related_people.name: Mithredath
related_people.role: Cyrus's treasurer, who counted out the temple vessels for the return

description: The empire that conquered Babylon and, under Cyrus, issued the decree allowing exiled Jews to return and rebuild Jerusalem's temple (Ezra 1:1-4; 2 Chronicles 36:20-23). Esther became queen of Persia under Ahasuerus, and Daniel served in its administration under Darius, surviving the lions' den (Daniel 6).
